# Recovery prompt

Use this when a fresh session resumes an item whose named owner is absent, unresponsive, orphaned, or simply not this session.

Ownership is a role, not a session: never wait on an absent/orphaned owner or ask the Chairman to find old chats. The current session assumes leadership, records the takeover in the source-linked handoff, and proceeds. Independent review is still required; never self-merge or approve. No purchases, bypass flags, or secret exposure.

`HANDOFF_SOURCE_LINK_V1`: read the full brief from the reviewed GitHub link. Slack carries only the recipient, one scoped action, that link, and the return. Do not ask the Chairman to locate an old chat.

An explicit safety or permission denial ends that action. Do not retry it through another tool, account, or connector. Reconcile a live writer or EFFECT_UNKNOWN before repeating it, then continue independent permitted work.
